items.t: Automatic transmission shifts hard or fails
items.job: Replace valve body/solenoids or install remanufactured transmission
items.note: A valve body repair is the low end. CarComplaints owners of same-platform Volvos report $3,000-$4,800 for a full transmission.

items.t: Clogged PCV system pushes out oil seals
items.job: Replace PCV oil trap, hoses and intake gasket
items.note: Leaking seals that were pushed out cost extra.

items.t: AWD angle gear wears out and leaks
items.job: Replace or rebuild AWD angle gear

items.t: ABS module fails and turns on warning lights
items.job: Repair or replace ABS control module

items.t: Central electronic module (CEM) faults
items.job: Repair or replace and program the CEM

items.t: Worn front control arm bushings
items.job: Replace front control arms or bushings and align

items.t: Engine burns oil and may fail
items.job: Replace pistons and rings (or install a replacement engine)
items.note: CarComplaints owners report $2,700-$4,700 on average, and $7,800 for sudden engine failure on 2012 models.

items.t: Low oil level warning from faulty dipstick
items.job: Replace oil dipstick and update engine software

items.t: Hissing at idle from torn PCV diaphragm
items.job: Replace PCV valve / oil separator

items.t: Valve cover and accessory drive oil leaks
items.job: Reseal valve cover or replace accessory drive seal

items.t: Door won't lock or unlock with the remote
items.job: Replace door lock actuator / latch

items.t: Sunroof drains clog and leak water inside
items.job: Clear sunroof drain tubes

items.t: 12V battery drains and car won't start
items.job: Software update and 12V battery replacement if damaged
items.note: Software fixes are covered under warranty.

items.t: Center screen freezes or gets stuck restarting
items.job: Infotainment software reload or head unit replacement
items.note: Usually a software reload under warranty.

items.t: Sensus touchscreen glitches and false alerts
items.job: Infotainment software update

items.t: Vibration or shudder when braking
items.job: Replace front brake pads (and rotors if needed)

items.t: Throttle body fault causes stalling and limp mode (recall)
items.job: Update software or replace electronic throttle module
items.note: The recall software update is free. The old extended throttle warranty has ended; a throttle body out of pocket runs a few hundred dollars plus labor.

items.t: Driver airbag inflator can rupture (recall)
items.job: Replace driver airbag inflator
items.note: Free at a Volvo dealer under recall 21V-766. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Fuel pump flange can crack and leak (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel pump flange
items.note: Free at a Volvo dealer under recall 09V-483. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Fuel pressure sensor can cause misfires and stalling (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel pressure sensor
items.note: Free at a Volvo dealer under recall 07V-226. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Electric cooling fan can overheat and start a fire (recall)
items.job: Replace cooling fan assembly
items.note: Free at a Volvo dealer under recall 04V-451. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Front control arm nut can loosen (recall)
items.job: Inspect and tighten or replace control arm hardware
items.note: Free at a Volvo dealer under recall 04V-029. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Front seat belt anchor cable can break (recall)
items.job: Replace front seat belt anchor cables
items.note: Free at a Volvo dealer under recall 20V-378. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Door can look closed but not latch (recall)
items.job: Replace door latches
items.note: Free at a Volvo dealer under recall 19V-849. Check your VIN first.

items.t: No warning for low oil pressure (recall)
items.job: Update software / repair oil pressure warning
items.note: Free at a Volvo dealer under recall 13V-592. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Fuel line connector can come loose (recall)
items.job: Secure fuel line connector
items.note: Free at a Volvo dealer under recall 11V-311. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Engine can stall suddenly from software fuel cut-off (recall)
items.job: Update engine control software
items.note: Free at a Volvo dealer under recall 10V-579. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Wipers run nonstop and lights can fail (recall)
items.job: Update or replace central electronic module
items.note: Free at a Volvo dealer under recall 13V-377. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Side airbags may not inflate in a crash (recall)
items.job: Replace side airbag modules
items.note: Free at a Volvo dealer under recall 17V-127. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Passenger airbag may not be secured (recall)
items.job: Inspect and secure passenger airbag
items.note: Free at a Volvo dealer under recall 23V-780. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Automatic emergency braking may not detect obstacles (recall)
items.job: Update active safety module software
items.note: Free at a Volvo dealer under recall 20V-144. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Fuel pump fuse can blow and stall the engine (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel pump fuse
items.note: Free at a Volvo dealer under recall 21V-414. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Plug-in hybrid battery can short circuit (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace high-voltage battery modules
items.note: Free at a Volvo dealer under recall 25V-179. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Gas engine may not start on plug-in hybrid (recall)
items.job: Update engine control software
items.note: Free at a Volvo dealer under recall 22V-793. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Backup camera image may not appear (recall)
items.job: Update camera software
items.note: Free at a Volvo dealer under recall 25V-908. Check your VIN first.
